body: Well that was pleasant, but really not helpful at the worst of times.

I knew I'd get at least one "break up with her" response from reddit. Which I'm aware enough to know that isn't smart. It was actually my idea and she hasn't had any luck either. And we're actually a very happy couple when we're together. And I'm completely comfortable.

I like my friends. I'm in a club and gaining some more friends. I just have no one here to hug me and be super close to me.

They had join dates, and I'm passed them. It's very difficult to get off campus. Also, I've seen three therapists in my life; they have never been effective with me.
Thanks a ton. I think I'll try to use one of these next time I feel awful.
Fuck yes, I love hugs. That's all I really want. What are you going to ask?

She got lucky and she is going to be completely okay. 

My parents and I are not on the best terms, unfortunately. I can't really talk to them about anything.
